Subject: SOC 2 Type II — audit window & privileged session retention evidence needed

Hi Logan (and team),

We are preparing the SOC 2 Type II procedures for Aurora Health's upcoming audit and need a few clarifications and supplemental artifacts from Redwood to complete the privileged access and logging control workstreams. Please see the items below — if you can confirm scope and a proposed delivery timeline by EOD Thursday 12/3 that would be great.

Requested items (priority order):
1) Audit window / bridge: Confirm whether Redwood will provide a signed bridge letter covering the gap between your last Type II period and the requested audit window (Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026). If yes, include the intended bridge wording and signer.

2) Privileged session retention & recording evidence:
   - Policy that defines recording/retention for privileged sessions (PAM or SSH session recording).
   - A sample set of 5 privileged session recordings (or metadata manifest) that show timestamps, user/role, target host, and retention metadata. Redactions are fine for PII — we primarily need proof of retention and chain-of-custody (when recording created, when deleted).

3) Access review evidence:
   - Most recent quarterly access review for two high-impact groups (suggested targets: prod-admins, infra-deploy). Deliver the review spreadsheet(s) and reviewer sign-off evidence.

4) Service account rotation proof:
   - Rotation logs or vault audit showing service account credential rotations for three highest-privilege service accounts during the period.

5) Exported session logs or sampling approach: If you cannot export full recordings, provide an index/manifest plus a sampling plan we can accept for substantive testing.

Preferred delivery: password-protected zip uploaded to the secure Drive folder we provided (link below) OR a signed SFTP transfer agreement. Please include a short note describing any redaction or masking applied and any expected delays.

Attachments: none from our side in this message.

Drive link for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-audit-samples
HubSpot: HUBSPOT-REC-00048729

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if easier to align.

Best,
Emily Cheung
